commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Ath Bilbao show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. It's a throw-in for Ath Bilbao.
90+3' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
90+1' The attendance is 34642.

88' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' Sevilla are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
86' The yellow card is received by Joan Jordan (Sevilla).
84' Akor Adams (Sevilla) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Unai Simon sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.

83' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Ath Bilbao are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
81' Substitution. Isaac Romero did his best and is replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).

77' Looks like Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

75' What an amazing save by Odysseas Vlachodimos! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the middle of the target, but fails.
73' Ath Bilbao take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

73' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.
73' Matias Almeyda prepares a substitution. Nemanja Gudelj is replaced by Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla).

70' Peque (Sevilla) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

70' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.

66' Kike Salas (Sevilla) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom right corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
65' Peque (Sevilla) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
64' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
62' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
62' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.

24' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Sevilla players aren’t happy.
22' Goal! Kike Salas provides Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort under the bar. 1:0.
21' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
21' Izeta (Ath Bilbao) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
18' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
16' Unai Simon displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Akor Adams (Sevilla) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
14' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
13' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

13' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) gets the ball from a rebound before trying his luck with a good long-range shot which threatens the goalkeeper! The ball sails painfully wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
12' Sevilla showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Ath Bilbao.
